Implementation Plan

## Files likely to change

- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Functions or modules to implement

None. This is a data-only change: replace the whole content of `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` with exactly these three lines, followed by one trailing newline:

```
status: ok
run_id: 39694107256
updated-by: ai-pipeline
```

The equivalent command is `printf 'status: ok\nrun_id: 39694107256\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n' > tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue fully specifies one file and its exact bytes, so the plan covers that and nothing more. No helper, pattern or new structure applies. It touches no automation paths, so no grant is needed.

## Data structures affected

Only the plain-text canary file. It has no schema and no parser.

## API or interface changes

None.

## Decisions

### D1 — Overwrite the file completely
- Chosen: write the three lines with a single trailing newline, replacing everything in the file.
- Alternatives considered: editing individual lines in place; keeping the existing content.
- Why: the issue requires exactly three lines and nothing else, and a full overwrite is the only way to guarantee that.

## Security considerations

- No trust boundary, endpoint, credential or money state is touched.
- The content is a fixed literal and nothing in it is executed, so there is no injection or abuse case.

## Potential risks or edge cases

- A test may read this canary file: grep `tests/` for `e2e_smoke_canary` before and after the change, and leave any such test unedited.
- The run must not leave a missing trailing newline, an extra blank line, CRLF line endings or other files in the commit; check with `git diff --stat`.
- The pipeline's own generated files (manifest, changelog fragment) must stay out of this commit, because the issue allows changing only this one file.

## Testing considerations

- `diff <(printf 'status: ok\nrun_id: 39694107256\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n') tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` prints nothing.
- `git diff --name-only` lists only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.

## Pre-execution self-check

The plan lists the one file, keeps to the issue's scope and needs no clarification.
